entries.title: Psalms 93:1
segments: Jehovah reigneth; he is clothed with majesty; Jehovah is clothed with strength; he hath girded himself therewith: The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 93:2
segments: Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.

entries.title: Psalms 93:3
segments: The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their  waves.

entries.title: Psalms 93:4
segments: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, Jehovah on high is mighty.

entries.title: Psalms 93:5
segments: Thy testimonies are very sure: Holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for evermore.
